mapper.update: UPDATE roomprice SET roomType = #{roomType}, roomWkPrice = #{roomWkPrice}, roomWkndPrice = #{roomWkndPrice}, roomSWkPrice = #{roomSWkPrice}, roomSWkndPrice = #{roomSWkndPrice}, roomUWkPrice = #{roomUWkPrice}, roomUWkndPrice = #{roomUWkndPrice}, roomSfWkPrice = #{roomSfWkPrice}, roomSfWkndPrice = #{roomSfWkndPrice} WHERE roomType = #{roomType}
mapper.select:
SELECT A.roomType AS "roomType", A.roomId AS "roomId", A.roomNm AS "roomNm", COALESCE(B.roomWkPrice, '') AS "roomWkPrice", COALESCE(B.roomWkndPrice, '') AS "roomWkndPrice", COALESCE(B.roomSWkPrice, '') AS "roomSWkPrice", COALESCE(B.roomSWkndPrice, '') AS "roomSWkndPrice", COALESCE(B.roomUWkPrice, '') AS "roomUWkPrice", COALESCE(B.roomUWkndPrice, '') AS "roomUWkndPrice", COALESCE(B.roomSfWkPrice, '') AS "roomSfWkPrice", COALESCE(B.roomSfWkndPrice, '') AS "roomSfWkndPrice" FROM room A LEFT JOIN roomprice B ON A.roomType = B.roomType
WHERE A.roomType = #{roomType}
SELECT periodNum, periodNm, periodStart, periodEnd FROM period

choose.otherwise: INSERT INTO period (periodNm, periodStart, periodEnd) VALUES (#{periodNm}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd})
